detached_structure.evidence: A small rectangular roofed structure, possibly a shed or covered deck, sits just behind and to the right of the house near a round patio/table, partially shaded by trees.

signals.notes: Long narrow lot with a house at the front and dense mature tree canopy covering the entire rear half; the front lawn is open but shaded, and the roof looks somewhat weathered with a mottled tan/brown appearance.
